summary_1line: Astika halts Takshaka midair and persuades King Janamejaya to end the snake‑sacrifice, saving the serpent race and receiving a boon protecting readers from snake harm.

image_candidates.scene_text: Takshaka hangs suspended in the sky after being cast from Indra's hands while the blazing sacrificial fire waits below.
Young sage Astika raises his hand and commands 'Stay' three times, freezing the falling serpent midair above the altar.
King Janamejaya ends the great snake‑sacrifice as priests and onlookers rejoice around the still‑burning ritual fire.
